extDescription.message: Drop a screenshot, get a short link that expires. Stored on your own Cloudflare R2, made for handing screenshots to AI agents.

empty.message: Your links will show up here. They expire on their own.

readError.message: Couldn't read the file. If you dragged the floating thumbnail, try the saved file.

missingConfig.message: Set up your server first: open Settings.

copyAgentTitle.message: Copy an instruction for an AI agent to download and read it

agentPrompt.message: Look at this screenshot. Download it with `curl -so /tmp/{file} {url}` and read /tmp/{file}

deleteTitle.message: Delete now: the link stops working immediately

deleted.message: Deleted ✓ The link no longer works.

errNotConfigured.message: Your server has no UPLOAD_TOKEN set.

errUnsupported.message: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images.

optSub.message: Where your screenshots go and which token uploads them.

endpointHelp.message: Your Worker's address, for example https://shotdrop.your-account.workers.dev

tokenHelp.message: The UPLOAD_TOKEN you set when deploying.

copyModeAgent.message: An instruction for an AI agent

connBadToken.message: The server answers, but the token is not valid.

connNotConfigured.message: The server answers, but it has no UPLOAD_TOKEN set.

noServerBody.message: Deploy your own on Cloudflare in one click. It takes about two minutes and your screenshots stay in your account.

securityNote.message: The token can only upload and delete. If it leaks, rotate it with {cmd} and paste the new one here. Your R2 keys never touch the browser.
